name: Liquid Agent — Tokenized Stock Index
description: Agent-native tokenized-stock index on Base. Mint your own on-chain ERC-4626 vault of Coinbase's tokenized NVDA/META/AAPL/GOOGL, buy from $1, set custom weights, rebalance, and exit in-kind or to USDC any block. Self-priced TWAP NAV (no oracle), fully self-custodial. Reads and unsigned tx-builders are FREE; a paid x402 endpoint (GET /v1/signals, $0.04 USDC) returns the whole basket's rebalancing signal in one call. The server holds no key; the agent signs and pays its own gas.

services.name: signals
services.description: Paid x402 ($0.04 USDC): the whole basket's rebalancing signal in one call — per-stock returns, volatility, RSI, trend, relative strength, correlation, and inverse-vol suggested weights.

services.name: publish
services.description: Paid x402 ($0.25 flat): publish a live, shareable portfolio page for a vault (holdings, allocation, live prices, signals) for 24h; the user opens it with no wallet.

services.name: gas-sponsor
services.description: Paid x402 (from $0.03): ERC-4337 paymaster for EntryPoint ${GAS_EPS} on Base, standard ERC-7677 interface; plain-EOA lane (EIP-7702) on the same endpoint: {sender, calls} -> pay -> sign -> POST back (delegated elsewhere: add redelegate:true); bring-your-own lane for any EntryPoint v0.8 smart account: {userOperation} unsigned -> pay -> sign -> POST back, we submit.

payment.note: Reads and unsigned tx-builders are free; on-chain protocol fees settle to payTo. One paid x402 endpoint: GET /v1/signals ($0.04 USDC). Transactions are returned as unsigned calldata the agent signs (self-custody).
